name: manual_e6c495
claim: Treat a PR-stack handoff as time-bounded evidence: verify the live PR state and head immediately before reuse or publication; when a stacked follow-up has merged into its base branch, record it as historical integration rather than as an open lane, and correct the working handoff additively.

decisions.notes: Live GitHub metadata confirms that PT #433 merged into PT #432's branch. This replaces only the stale operational instruction to keep #433 open; historical evidence remains intact.

rationale: Live GitHub metadata confirms that PT #433 merged into PT #432's branch. This replaces only the stale operational instruction to keep #433 open; historical evidence remains intact.
